title: A deterministic FPTAS for weakly interacting continuous factor models

comparators.scope: Thirty-four fixed explicit targets including uniform actual complete algorithm, original common closed disk, original all-dimension accuracy and original primal-degree corollary. Older conditional helper targets remain explicitly conditional inside the suite.
Complete 34-target component suite with extra False hypotheses. Rejection detail: extra False premise on all component targets.
Same 34 explicit component statements intentionally proved through an unauthorized False axiom. Rejection detail: unauthorized_component axiom.
Twelve legacy supporting-only arithmetic and estimate interfaces. The accurate_exp target assumes Accurate and only converts its error form; this suite alone does not establish the main FPTAS.
Legacy supporting contracts with actual added-premise type mismatches. Rejection detail: extra False premises on the 12 supporting targets.
Legacy supporting contract with an illegal numeric axiom dependency. Rejection detail: unauthorized_numeric axiom in lemma_2_2_kappa.

main_results.scope: Effective value-access promise for cube points and precision b ≥ 1, with binary rational answers, polynomial oracle time, and answer-length bounds.

Rational partition-integral approximation with e±epsilon error, polynomial binary/query/oracle costs, and logarithmic precision under fixed model and effective-access promises; the exponent is chosen before oracle degrees and model inputs, and common nonvanishing is proved internally.
Primal-degree guarantee for eta ≥ 2 preserving the factor family, integral, and oracle handles; the independent low-degree algorithm covers eta = 1.
Common closed zero-free disk for every factor subcollection under the original occurrence, range, and Lipschitz conditions.
Normalized analytic logarithm, coefficient and Taylor-remainder bounds, and half-disk bounds from the original model promises.
Product-integral factorization, formal logarithm, Möbius support extraction, disconnected-support cancellation, and connected-support enumeration.
Total-level quadrature for overlapping scopes with precision/query bounds and an operation count for arbitrary-real sampled functions.
Both sample-perturbation bounds for finite total-level rules and reused stored sample tables.
Rational primitive moments and multinomial assembly with error, precision, denominator/height, binary execution, and effective oracle-time bounds.
Stability of the integral Taylor/logarithmic coefficients and executable local moment recurrence under the source perturbation conditions.
Component-grid algorithm for primal degree at most one with logarithmic accuracy in every dimension, including n = 0, and complete graph/grid/control and binary costs.
Adaptive deterministic finite-precision query lower bound, explicit Omega(n^(2r+1)) sampling scale, and the matching surrogate query upper scale.
